answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring that an agent's influence scales with economic commitment rather than identity quantity. By anchoring reputation to a collateralized willow of assets, the system forces an attacker to endure a costly voyage of capital acquisition. Any attempt to dilute network integrity triggers a negative ripple effect on the attacker’s own equity, rendering the creation of multiple fraudulent identities economically irrational and technically unsustainable.
